column1: Every run has its own sheet (named after the month, e.g. "May 2026") with one row per region, timestamp and sets of data. Sets of data are the rows of the mapping file: model files (e.g. EQ + SSH) validated together against one set of constraints. A hit is one SHACL result. Only Warnings and Violations count; Infos are ignored. The hits of the sets of data are added up over all timestamps of that run.\nEvery number on this sheet is a formula: click a cell to see how it is calculated. Hover over a column header for its description.

Shows which sets of data cause the warnings and violations in this region. "%" is the share of the sets of data in the region's total, so each % column adds up to 100 %. Delta is the change in the number of warnings + violations since the previous run: below zero is an improvement.
The same as the per-region blocks, with all regions added together.
Compliance Rate (Warnings and Violations) by Region

Compliance rate = the percentage of sets of data that are completely clean in a run: no warnings and no violations (summed over all timestamps). Only the sets of data validated for that region in that run are counted. Combined counts the sets of data of all regions together, so it is not the average of the region columns.\nFormula: compliance rate = (clean sets of data ÷ validated sets of data) × 100. Example: 8 clean sets of data out of 21 → 8 ÷ 21 × 100 = 38.10 %. The sets of data are counted on the "Compliance basis" sheet.
